build_sparse_downsample: build a SparseDownsample module to downsample a sparse tensor by a given factor using average pooling
build_sparse_upsample: build a SparseUpsample module to upsample a sparse tensor by a given factor using nearest neighbor interpolation
build_sparse_subdivide: build a SparseSubdivide module to upsample a sparse tensor by subdividing each spatial location into 2^DIM neighbors
review_sparse_downsample_forward: review the SparseDownsample forward method to understand how average pooling is applied to sparse tensor features
review_sparse_upsample_forward: review the SparseUpsample forward method to understand how cached coordinates and indices are used for nearest neighbor upsampling
